# DDS-Digital

> বাংলাদেশের ১ নম্বর ডিজিটাল প্রোডাক্ট মার্কেটপ্লেস — সাবস্ক্রিপশন, সফটওয়্যার, অ্যাকাউন্ট ইনস্ট্যান্ট অটো ডেলিভারির মাধ্যমে।

DDS-Digital (Dev Sabbir Soft) is Bangladesh's digital product selling platform offering subscriptions, software, and accounts with instant auto-delivery, secure payment (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, cards), and 24/7 support.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured digital products, categories, and offers.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse all digital products with filters and search.
- [Blog](/blog): Tips, guides, reviews, and platform updates.
- [FAQ](/faq): Frequently asked questions about delivery, payment, and support.
- [About](/about): Our story, mission, and vision.
- [Developer](/developer): About the developer behind DDS-Digital.

## Programs

- [Affiliate Program](/apply-affiliate): Earn commission by referring customers.
- [Become a Seller](/apply-seller): Sell your digital products on DDS-Digital.
